features.name: loc
features.definition: Total physical lines in the unit span, including the signature.

language_notes.python: Count both lines in def f(): followed by an assignment.
language_notes.javascript: Count all three lines in a function declaration with one statement.
language_notes.typescript: Count all three lines in a typed function declaration with one return statement.

features.implementation_method: Count source lines over the selected unit span; unit selection follows 0.9.8.

features.name: v(g)

language_notes.python: Count if/elif, loops, non-default match cases, except, conditional expressions, and/or, and comprehension for/if decision nodes.
language_notes.javascript: Count if, loops, non-default switch cases, catch, ternary, and short-circuit &&, ||, ??, &&=, ||=, ??=; optional chaining is not a decision point.
language_notes.typescript: Count if, loops, non-default switch cases, catch, ternary, and short-circuit &&, ||, ??, &&=, ||=, ??=; optional chaining is not a decision point.

features.implementation_method: Tree-sitter decision-node and token walk under the 0.9.4 rules.

features.name: uniq_Op
features.definition: Number of distinct operator tokens under the approved token convention.

language_notes.python: Count distinct operator lexemes, including keyword operators; comments are excluded.
language_notes.javascript: Count distinct operator lexemes, including keyword operators; comments are excluded.
language_notes.typescript: Count distinct operator lexemes, including keyword operators; comments and type-only syntax are excluded.

features.implementation_method: Tree-sitter token walk; count distinct operator lexemes.

features.name: uniq_Opnd
features.definition: Number of distinct non-keyword identifiers and literals.

language_notes.python: Count distinct non-keyword identifier and literal lexemes; docstring strings are excluded.
language_notes.javascript: Count distinct non-keyword identifier and literal lexemes; JSX tag and attribute names are operands, JSX text is ignored.
language_notes.typescript: Count distinct non-keyword identifier and literal lexemes; JSX tag and attribute names are operands, JSX text and type-only syntax are excluded.

features.implementation_method: Tree-sitter token walk; count distinct operand lexemes.

features.name: total_Op

language_notes.python: Count operator-token occurrences; comments are excluded.
language_notes.javascript: Count operator-token occurrences; comments are excluded.
language_notes.typescript: Count operator-token occurrences; comments and type-only syntax are excluded.

features.implementation_method: Tree-sitter token walk; count operator occurrences.

features.name: total_Opnd

language_notes.python: Count non-keyword identifier and literal occurrences; docstring strings are excluded.
language_notes.javascript: Count non-keyword identifier and literal occurrences; JSX tag and attribute names count, JSX text is ignored.
language_notes.typescript: Count non-keyword identifier and literal occurrences; JSX tag and attribute names count, JSX text and type-only syntax are excluded.

features.implementation_method: Tree-sitter token walk; count operand occurrences.

features.name: n

language_notes.python: Derived from total_Op and total_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from total_Op and total_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from total_Op and total_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.

features.source_dataset_column: derived from total_Op + total_Opnd (n = total_Op + total_Opnd)
features.implementation_method: Derived from the two total-count base features.

features.name: v
features.definition: Halstead volume: v = N * log2(vocabulary), where N = total_Op + total_Opnd and vocabulary = uniq_Op + uniq_Opnd.

language_notes.python: Derived from the four operator and operand counts; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from the four operator and operand counts; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from the four operator and operand counts; no language-specific extraction.

features.source_dataset_column: derived from total_Op, total_Opnd, uniq_Op, uniq_Opnd (v = N * log2(vocabulary))
features.implementation_method: Derived using the recorded Halstead volume formula.

features.name: l

language_notes.python: Derived from d; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from d; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from d; no language-specific extraction.

features.implementation_method: Derived from difficulty using the recorded formula.

features.name: d

language_notes.python: Derived from uniq_Op and total_Opnd / uniq_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from uniq_Op and total_Opnd / uniq_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from uniq_Op and total_Opnd / uniq_Opnd; no language-specific extraction.

features.source_dataset_column: derived from uniq_Op, total_Opnd, uniq_Opnd (d = (uniq_Op / 2) * (total_Opnd / uniq_Opnd))
features.implementation_method: Derived using the recorded Halstead difficulty formula.

features.name: i

language_notes.python: Derived from v and d; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from v and d; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from v and d; no language-specific extraction.

features.source_dataset_column: derived from v and d (i = v / d)
features.implementation_method: Derived using the recorded Halstead intelligence formula.

features.name: b

language_notes.python: Derived from v; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.javascript: Derived from v; no language-specific extraction.
language_notes.typescript: Derived from v; no language-specific extraction.

features.implementation_method: Derived using the better-fitting tested relation, v / 3000.

conventions.zero_operand: When uniq_Opnd = 0, set d = l = i = 0.
conventions.volume: Compute v from v = N * log2(vocabulary), where N = total_Op + total_Opnd and vocabulary = uniq_Op + uniq_Opnd.
conventions.zero_vocabulary: Set v = 0 when vocabulary = 0; this case is untested by JM1.
